mapper.select: SELECT smId, name, type, price FROM setmeal WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY smId
SELECT smId, name, type, price FROM setmeal WHERE smId = #{smId}

SELECT c.ciId AS item_id,c.ciName AS item_name,c.ciContent AS item_content,c.meaning AS item_meaning, d.cdId AS detail_id,d.name AS detail_name,d.unit AS detail_unit,d.normalValueString AS detail_range FROM setmealdetailed s JOIN checkitem c ON c.ciId=s.ciId LEFT JOIN checkitemdetailed d ON d.ciId=c.ciId WHERE s.smId=#{smId} ORDER BY c.ciId,d.cdId
